In North Carolina, a Drone Pilot Maps the Coast as the Sea Swallows Homes

August 18, 2026 Commercial UAV News drone, GIS, coastal erosion, Outer Banks, North Carolina, Dare County, DJI Matrice 350 RTK, sea level rise, digital twin, beach nourishment
Read the source article

Quick summary

A GIS analyst in Dare County, North Carolina uses a DJI Matrice 350 RTK drone to map coastal erosion along the Outer Banks, where 20 homes have been lost to the sea since September 2025 — creating detailed aerial documentation of a coastline in crisis.

Key takeaways

  • 20 homes have been lost in Buxton, NC since September 2025, with as many as 5 collapsing in a single day
  • Kristen Stilson, a GIS analyst for Dare County, uses a DJI Matrice 350 RTK drone to map coastal erosion
  • Between September 15 and October 28, 2025, 15 homes were lost in the village of Buxton alone
  • The coast has shrunk by more than 10 feet (3 meters) annually in some places
  • Beach nourishment every five years is the current strategy to protect NC Highway 12, the primary road to Dare County
